name: 32k_40k

information.decoder: train-only diagonal nearest-centroid softmax; validation shrinkage/temperature including uniform

controls.shuffled_labels: Independently permuted balanced feature-to-label assignments in train, validation and test.
controls.identical_clones: Feature-level exact null: repeat child0 features under every label, retaining independent noise splits. This is a decoder check, not another generator evaluation.

information.interpretation: Held-out estimate of a decoder-dependent conditional MI lower bound, not exact entropy. Negative estimates retained. Parent SE is descriptive, not uncertainty across training runs.

variance.note: Finite-sample balanced ANOVA fractions; between-mean terms contain estimation noise. Descriptive feature dispersion, not semantic mode count.

protocol.distance_precision: FP32 exact chunked squared Euclidean distances
protocol.density_definition: Mean real-neighborhood memberships per fake, divided by k
protocol.coverage_definition: Fraction of real kNN balls containing at least one fake; strict radius comparisons
